title: Recommended introduction to triana market with  samples of the vast choices of food & wines
text: Excellent introduction to triana market and local foods. Starting point the cooking school at stall 77  inside the market. Small group meant we could easily hear and ask questions.  Markets food choice  is so vast and this gave a useful start of olive varieties,  spices, dried tuna, charcuterie and mini desserts plus 3 wines/sherry samples.
author: Martin W
